question: How can regular contributions and minimum-balance rules affect your comparison of subscription-based and asset-based advisory fees?
answer: Regularly adding money may make a subscription fee more affordable than relying on investment growth alone to increase your account balance. But you may not be able to choose an asset-based fee if you do not meet an adviser’s minimum balance, and a subscription fee may convert to an asset-based fee when your account reaches a specified amount. Check the adviser’s terms for these rules.
